detector.reason: Dunhurst’s red card is followed by Linbridge spending more time in the attacking half and forcing a clear drop in opponent pass completion.

explanation.claim: After Dunhurst’s red card Linbridge Harriers took over: time-based possession rose from 42.3% to 66.6% and final-third field tilt from 31.4% to 83.5%, putting Dunhurst under sustained pressure. That pressure cut Dunhurst’s pass completion from 65.0% to 57.4% and halved Linbridge’s PPDA to 3.2, creating more chances (xT up).

caption.text: Linbridge have taken control after the red card, with possession and final-third pressure both rising sharply.

personas.headline: Linbridge seize control after red
personas.text: After Dunhurst’s red card, Linbridge Harriers took over: time-based possession jumped from 42.3% to 66.6%, and final-third field tilt from 31.4% to 83.5%. Dunhurst’s pass completion fell to 57.4%, while Linbridge’s PPDA halved to 3.2.

personas.headline: Linbridge cambiano ritmo dopo il rosso
personas.text: Dopo il rosso a Dunhurst, Linbridge Harriers hanno preso il controllo: il possesso (a tempo) è salito dal 42.3% al 66.6% e il field tilt nell’ultimo terzo dal 31.4% all’83.5%. La pressione ha abbassato il pass completion di Dunhurst al 57.4% e ha dimezzato il PPDA di Linbridge a 3.2.

personas.headline: Linbridge toman el mando tras la roja
personas.text: Tras la roja de Dunhurst, Linbridge Harriers mandaron: la posesión (por tiempo) subió del 42.3% al 66.6% y el field tilt en el último tercio del 31.4% al 83.5%. Dunhurst bajó su pass completion al 57.4% y el PPDA de Linbridge se redujo a 3.2.

personas.headline: Linbridge turn the game around
personas.text: Dunhurst’s red card changed everything, and Linbridge Harriers started to control the match. They kept the ball more, pushed higher up the pitch, and turned that pressure into more chances.

personas.headline: Linbridge cambiano la partita
personas.text: Il rosso a Dunhurst ha cambiato tutto e Linbridge Harriers hanno preso in mano il match. Hanno tenuto più palla, spinto più in alto e trasformato la pressione in più occasioni.

personas.headline: Linbridge cambian el partido
personas.text: La roja de Dunhurst lo cambió todo y Linbridge Harriers empezaron a mandar en el partido. Tuvieron más posesión, empujaron más arriba y con esa presión crearon más ocasiones.

personas.headline: Linbridge drive on after red
personas.text: With Dunhurst down to a red card, Linbridge Harriers took control and kept pushing. Their time-based possession and final-third field tilt both surged, while their pressure forced Dunhurst’s passing down.

personas.headline: Linbridge spingono dopo il rosso
personas.text: Con Dunhurst in dieci, Linbridge Harriers hanno preso il controllo e hanno continuato a spingere. Il loro possesso (a tempo) e il field tilt nell’ultimo terzo sono saliti nettamente, mettendo Dunhurst sotto pressione.
